claim: Restate executes stateful services and workflows as virtual actors whose execution progress is recorded in an append-only event journal, replayed deterministically to reconstruct in-memory execution state.
mechanism: InvocationStateMachine matches service execution steps against existing journal records, advancing the execution pointer and appending new entries to PartitionDb on new operations.
applicabilityConditions: All Restate virtual object and workflow service invocations
localContext: InvocationStateMachine matches service execution steps against existing journal records, advancing the execution pointer and appending new entries to PartitionDb on new operations. Known limits: Side effects must be wrapped in restate.run() or calls to be captured in the journal.

applicabilityConditions: All service invocations communicating via restate-service-protocol
localContext: ServiceProtocolCodec parses stream messages. When a call encounters an uncompleted promise/awakeable, a SuspensionMessage is yielded and the connection closes gracefully.
